event_text: Unauthorised access to servers in Planet IC's data centre in Schwerin
Wemag says its customer portals are offline after an attack on its hosting provider
dpa reports that Planet IC confirmed the attack and that several city websites are down
NRW.BANK takes its website offline as a precaution
Schwerin's and Greifswald's websites, Wemag's portal and NRW.BANK's site are still down or limited at our check
